model.structure: three correlated Bernoulli routes (Gaussian copula rho 0.5): (a) letter Q4 sentence 'lower' 0.12; (b) P(the print carries a forward take-rate discussion capable of naming a driver) 0.78 x P(the driver named is incentives / new businesses / the pilot reducing it) 0.50 = 0.39; (c) explicit FY27 lower 0.06; YES = a | b | c = 0.473; strict convention (FY26 wording excluded, multiplier 0.50 derived) = 0.31
model.revision_2_changes: P(topic) 0.80 -> 0.78 (A16-08 accepted in part, not the audit's 0.65); strict multiplier 0.55 -> 0.50, derived rather than asserted (A16-23); flat prior removed from the blend, weights 0.5/0.3/0.2 -> 0.65/0.35 (A16-13); claim 7 re-based to R04 rev 2's 0.52 (A16-14); section 9 rebuilt on R04's split_by_form and both margin rows re-computed on a falling revenue denominator (A16-02, A16-03)
model.conventions: statement must be forward-looking at 5 Nov, forward IN FORM (expect/anticipate/will), with a period extending into 4Q26 or FY27 (an FY26 statement on 5 Nov qualifies; a retrospective 'our 9M take rate was held back by incentives' does not; 3Q26 realised does not); leg (a) requires 'lower/down/decline' y/y (flat/in-line do not count alone); leg (b) requires incentives, new businesses or the host-fee/direct-link pilot named as reducing the forward take rate (the 2Q26 call form counts; RNPL timing alone counts only under (a)); convention (5): 'flat' OR 'up slightly' with incentives named as an offset to gains counts, so a direction upgrade alone does not resolve No - only dropping the incentives clause does; letter, prepared remarks and Q&A all count

The FY27 EPS full mark -$0.21 = $0.0014 x $153M was correct in rev 1 and does not move.
